title: Evolve CIMA GR official product information
notes: Current exact-model page supports a 750 g unpainted size-M frame, 375 g unpainted fork, BSA 68 mm, UDH, 50C clearance, 1x mechanical/electronic and 2x electronic routing, standard steel headset bearings, limited lifetime warranty and a 109 kg rider limit. The official gravel FAQ clarifies 50C with 1x and 45C with 2x, each with 6 mm side clearance. Long-term owner evidence is not yet available.
